nodes.name: Choose treatment
nodes.notes: Reproduced from the user-supplied image. Rows are treated as mutually exclusive, exhaustive outcomes per strategy; costs and QALYs are total outcomes per person, not additional repeated charges. Time horizon, perspective, exact dollar currency and currency year were not supplied. No willingness-to-pay threshold was supplied; the native WTP field is zero only as a required software placeholder. Amua uses it for root net-benefit optimization: do not interpret the automatic root choice until a real threshold is supplied. Only the per-strategy outcomes and incremental ICER are verified here. Drug A is the reference for incremental comparisons only. No preferred treatment is asserted.
